Title: Technical approach analysis for SAP AI Launchpad POC
Description: Analyze sap-rpt-1 model capabilities, API surface, supported use cases, and token/context limits. Compare against POC requirements. Produce a capability matrix.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Capability matrix document produced
- API surface documented (endpoints, auth, limits)
- Supported use cases identified
- Gaps vs. POC requirements listed

Title: Define POC evaluation criteria & success metrics
Description: Define what good looks like: response quality, latency, hallucination rate, coverage of CDD/NCDD domain questions.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Success metrics defined and agreed by team
- Minimum quality threshold set per metric
- Evaluation scoring template created

Title: Identify data sources for grounding / RAG
Description: Determine which SAP data (ABAP source, DDIC, CDS views, CDD CR data) to feed as context. Decide: pure prompt-based vs. retrieval-augmented.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Data source list finalized
- Grounding strategy decided (prompt-only vs. RAG)
- Decision recorded as ADR

Title: Assess data privacy & compliance constraints
Description: Check what data can be sent to BTP AI Launchpad. Identify PII, transport-sensitive data, and any restrictions on sending ABAP source code externally.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Compliance review completed
- List of data types approved/restricted produced
- Sign-off from compliance/security owner

Title: Benchmark sap-rpt-1 vs. existing sap-ai-assistant RAG approach
Description: Run same set of test prompts against both approaches. Document quality differences and coverage gaps.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Min. 20 prompts tested on both approaches
- Comparative results documented
- Recommendation on which to proceed with

Title: Design POC system architecture on BTP
Description: Define component diagram: BTP subaccount → AI Launchpad → sap-rpt-1 → integration layer → consumer (UI or API).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Component diagram produced
- All integration points documented
- Architecture reviewed and approved by team

Title: Decide on grounding strategy
Description: Architecture decision: direct prompt injection vs. RAG with vector store (SAP HANA Vector Engine or AI Core vector embedding). Produce ADR.
Acceptance Criteria:
- ADR produced and agreed
- Chosen approach documented with rationale
- Rejected alternatives documented

Title: Define API integration layer design
Description: Design the service bridging SAP system data and the AI Launchpad model API. Decide: Node.js adapter, CAP service, or direct BTP integration.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Integration layer design documented
- Technology choice made and justified
- API contract (request/response schema) defined

Title: Security & auth architecture
Description: mTLS/OAuth2 setup for BTP AI Core service binding. Define how credentials are managed (BTP credentials store).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Auth flow diagram produced
- Credential management approach defined
- No hardcoded secrets in any design

Title: Provision BTP subaccount for AI POC
Description: Create or reuse BTP subaccount. Assign required entitlements: SAP AI Launchpad, SAP AI Core, HANA Cloud (if needed for vector store).
Acceptance Criteria:
- BTP subaccount provisioned and accessible
- Required entitlements assigned
- Team members have appropriate access

Title: Set up SAP AI Launchpad instance
Description: Provision AI Launchpad service instance on BTP. Configure AI Core runtime. Deploy sap-rpt-1 model deployment in AI Core.
Acceptance Criteria:
- AI Launchpad instance running
- AI Core resource group configured
- sap-rpt-1 model deployment active and reachable

Title: Configure service bindings & API access
Description: Create AI Core service binding. Generate OAuth2 client credentials. Validate connectivity from development environment to AI Launchpad API endpoint.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Service binding created
- OAuth2 token can be obtained successfully
- Test API call to inference endpoint returns valid response

Title: Set up development environment
Description: Configure local or BTP-hosted dev environment to call AI Core inference API. Set up .env / BTP credentials for POC app.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Dev environment configured for all POC developers
- Credentials stored securely (not in repo)
- Sample call to API works from dev machine

Title: Validate ISD/SAP system connectivity for data extraction
Description: Confirm that the existing SAP MCP ADT connection (ISD system) can serve as the data source pipeline for grounding content.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Connection from POC environment to ISD confirmed
- Sample ABAP object fetch via ADT API works
- Data extraction pipeline end-to-end validated

Title: Implement AI Launchpad API client
Description: Build a thin client that calls the sap-rpt-1 inference endpoint via AI Core REST API. Handle auth, retry, and error responses.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Client handles OAuth2 token refresh
- Retry logic for transient errors implemented
- Unit tests cover success and error paths

Title: Build data extraction pipeline from ISD
Description: Extend existing weekly-sync pipeline to export CDD/NCDD-relevant data (classes, CDS views, DDIC) as structured context for prompts.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Pipeline exports CDD-relevant objects in structured format
- Output usable as prompt context or vector embedding input
- Incremental sync (only changed objects) works correctly

Title: Implement prompt engineering layer
Description: Design and test system prompts tailored to CDD/NCDD domain. Implement prompt templates for key use cases (CR analysis, W@R classification, impact assessment).
Acceptance Criteria:
- System prompt template defined and tested
- At least 3 use-case-specific prompt templates implemented
- Prompt outputs reviewed for quality and hallucination

Title: Implement RAG / context injection (if chosen in AR-2)
Description: Build retrieval layer: embed knowledge base chunks, store in vector DB, retrieve top-K relevant chunks per query, inject into prompt context.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Chunking strategy defined and implemented
- Vector embeddings generated for knowledge base
- Retrieval returns relevant chunks for test queries
- Injected context improves response quality vs. no-RAG baseline

Title: Build POC UI or API endpoint
Description: Simple chat interface or REST endpoint to query the model with CDD domain questions. Can be a BTP CAP app or standalone Node.js service.
Acceptance Criteria:
- POC UI/API accessible to stakeholders
- Supports free-text question input
- Returns formatted response with source references (if RAG)

Title: Integrate W@R scenario classification as a test case
Description: Implement a specific prompt/flow that classifies a given CDD CR line item into W@R scenario 1-6. Use as a concrete POC capability demo.
Acceptance Criteria:
- W@R scenario 1-6 definitions used as prompt context
- Model correctly classifies at least 80% of test CR items
- Classification output includes reasoning

Title: Run POC evaluation and document results
Description: Execute the test set defined in A-2 against the live model. Record accuracy, latency, and failure modes. Produce POC findings report.
Acceptance Criteria:
- All test cases from T-1 executed
- Results documented against metrics from A-2
- POC findings report produced and shared with stakeholders

Title: Define test question set for CDD/NCDD domain
Description: Curate 20-30 representative questions spanning CR analysis, W@R scenarios, approval logic, and DDIC lookups.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Minimum 20 questions defined
- Questions cover all target use cases
- Expected answers documented for scoring

Title: Evaluate model response quality (manual review)
Description: Score responses against expected answers. Measure: correctness, hallucination rate, relevance, and completeness.
Acceptance Criteria:
- All test questions scored
- Hallucination rate < defined threshold
- Summary of failure patterns produced

Title: Latency & cost profiling
Description: Measure end-to-end response times and token consumption. Estimate monthly cost at target usage volume.
Acceptance Criteria:
- p50/p95 latency measured and documented
- Token consumption per query profiled
- Monthly cost estimate at 3 usage tiers produced
